name: Seven Hotties, All My Husbands
storyline:
No way, since when did I get married?

"Be my wife and give birth to the one who becomes my heir".

"Smells nice and sweet. I decided to hug you for whole night to sleep."

"It's the duty of the wife to choose whom you're going to spend the night with for each nights."

7 husbands suddenly appears! And as their wife, you must listen to the 3 demands from them!?

You have been working as a freelance designer. You were having smooth career, but not being able to meet any nice guy...

"I wanna get married with a nice guy!" At that moment, you saw shooting star in the night sky...

When you woke up the next morning, you found yourself lying on a bed of an unknown luxurious room! Who was the guy holding you tightly inside his arms-!?
summary: An otome visual novel where a freelance designer wishes on a shooting star and wakes up in a luxurious mansion, suddenly married to seven distinct suitors. Players navigate branching romantic routes by choosing which husband to spend each night with while managing three unique demands from each suitor.
